caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile or rug with an intricate, wavy pattern. The main part of the rug features a swirling background dominated by varying shades of gray, with ridged, undulating lines creating a textured effect. There are two prominent floral motifs, one in the upper right corner, and a partial one in the lower right, each constructed from concentric layers of color. These motifs have petals primarily outlined in red, grayish blue, and cream, with centers in a muted pink and gray. The rug's border on the left and bottom edges consists of a braided or twisted pattern with repeating segments of red, blue, and beige. Interior to this braided border is a thinner, solid reddish-brown stripe running along the edge. The overall composition uses a limited palette with earth tones—gray, beige, cream, red, blue, and muted pink—applied in a painterly, textured manner.
title: Shaker Rug
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
